Like many Moblin weapons it's sloppily made, but this one packs some respectable piercing power.|Allies|AoC}} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== {{BotW Item Properties/Store |type = Weapon |strength = 9 |durability = 20 |flammable = Yes |magnetic = No |buoyant = Yes |conductive = No |guardian = No |throw = Yes |throw_effect = }} {{Compendium/Extract|Spiked Moblin Spear}} Spiked Moblin Spears are [[Weapon]]s carried by [[Blue Moblin]]s, primarily within the [[Gerudo Highlands]] and [[Akkala Highlands]]. They are made from [[Moblin Spear]]s by strapping horned [[Animal]] skulls to their ends. As is common for Moblin crafts, they are crudely made. Since they are made by Moblins, they belong to the [[Moblin Gear]] equipment archetype.{{Cite Book|quote= |book= CaC |publisher= |page= 174}} Being made of wood, Spiked Moblin Spears will float on [[Water (Terrain)|Water]] if they are dropped. They will also burn if they are exposed to [[Fire]] or equipped in a [[Scorching Climate]].
